lines.text: The discovery of the ruins was an accident. At least, that is what people believed.
It marked the dawn of an age that later historians would call the Age of Twilight.
A great quake struck the mountains between two great powers, the Kingdom of Asroit and the Republic of Baileste.
Then an old man of the mountain tribes found a strange stone giving off a dull glow.
The stone's light healed the injuries and illnesses of the old man and his neighbors,
and after saving several lives, it lost its glow and became a common pebble.
It was the very Azare Stone of myth and legend, the priceless treasure of eternal life.
Word of it swept across the continent in an instant.
The leaders of the two powers, though doubtful at first, ordered the site excavated.
And so Asla Fael, capital of the Sun Empire, came back into the sight of men after ten thousand years.
The ruins seemed a bottomless spring, pouring wealth on the leaders of both powers and their countries.
But one day, barely a year into the dig, monsters suddenly appeared in the ruins.
These unearthly creatures, unlike anything ever seen,
devoured those working the dig and wiped out the armies both powers sent.
Softened by long peace, the two leaders took fright, walled off the entrance to the ruins and sealed it.
Yet within a few years, a small town had sprung up inside those walls.
Though the terror of the monsters was still fresh in people's minds,
adventurers never stopped coming to the monster-haunted ruins below.
Some for wealth and fame,
some for the Azare Stone, the treasure of eternal life...
And so the underground ruins became a battlefield of monsters and adventurers.
